subject.title: [Bug]: Official ClawHub WhatsApp plugin cannot start linked account due to openKeyedStore trust check

question: May ClawSweeper implement a narrow official-install trust propagation fix for recorded ClawHub installs discovered as workspace-origin, while keeping raw workspace/load-path and `plugins.allow` installs untrusted?
rationale: The expected behavior follows the official plugin install contract, but the exact predicate decides which external plugin code receives host-managed persistent state and channel ingress APIs.

options.title: Approve narrow provenance fix
options.body: Trust only candidates whose official catalog identity, install record, and resolved install path all match, and add regression tests proving arbitrary workspace plugins remain denied.

options.title: Hold for broader trust design
options.body: Keep this blocked behind a wider external-plugin provenance design even though the reported official install record is otherwise normal.

options.title: Reject external trusted state expansion
options.body: Keep official user-extension installs denied until they load through an already-trusted origin, accepting that this WhatsApp install shape remains blocked.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow provenance fix
recommendation.body: Trust only candidates whose official catalog identity, install record, and resolved install path all match, and add regression tests proving arbitrary workspace plugins remain denied.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current line owner for the inspected plugin trust, runtime gate, and WhatsApp ingress changes.
